name: JOB HUNTING 9000
source:
JOB HUNTING 9000 DELUHX is a visual novel about being coerced into dating a shitty overpowered eyestrain 'OC' come to life, with an unnecessary amount of alternative routes as he attempts to help fix your life in the only way he knows how. Find all the routes! Choose your favourite route! Have a gall of a time! 

Game features gore and horror elements in some routes, as well as some suggestive material and innuendo. Please only play if you are age appropriate (15+ reccomended).

[From [url=https://axetrax1.itch.io/job-hunting-9000-deluhx]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《JOB HUNTING 9000 DELUHX》是一部视觉小说，讲述的是被迫与一位视力疲劳的“OC”约会，他试图以他知道的唯一方式帮助你改善生活，并有大量不必要的替代路线。找到所有路线！选择你最喜欢的路线！玩得开心吧！

游戏在某些路线中包含血腥和恐怖元素，以及一些暗示性材料和影射。请仅在适合年龄的情况下玩（建议15岁以上）。

[来自[url=https://axetrax1.itch.io/job-hunting-9000-deluhx]Itch.io[/url]]
